name: STANDALONE
negative_cell_standard: Source states item cannot constitute an utterance alone in this use, or describes it as bound to a host

name: SUPPLEMENT
negative_cell_standard: Source states the use is always integrated or always standalone, with the supplement environment addressed

name: INTEGRATED
negative_cell_standard: Source restricts the use to standalone and/or supplement positions

name: DEPENDENTS
negative_cell_standard: Source states the use takes no dependents/complements

name: INFLECTS
negative_cell_standard: Source states invariance, or gives a paradigm/description covering the relevant contrasts and shows one form

name: NOMINAL_COMB
negative_cell_standard: Attested determiner/number examples for Y; explicit unacceptability statement or conversion analysis in a source for N. Corpus silence is U.

name: NONPROP
negative_cell_standard: Source assigns ordinary descriptive/truth-conditional content to the use

name: STANCE
negative_cell_standard: Source characterizes the contribution without any evaluative/affective stance component (e.g. pure depiction or pure sequence management)

name: DEPICTIVE
negative_cell_standard: Source characterizes the contribution as non-iconic (e.g. purely symbolic/conventional with no resemblance claim)

name: REPETITION
negative_cell_standard: Categorical; code only where a source describes the effect of repetition for the item or its stated class

name: SCOPE
negative_cell_standard: Source reports the contribution is cancelled/embedded under negation or interrogation of the host

name: PROSODY
negative_cell_standard: Source reports characteristic intonational integration with a host for this use

name: PHONO_ANOM
negative_cell_standard: Source gives the conventional form(s) in full and all are within ordinary English word phonology

name: SEQACTION
negative_cell_standard: Categorical; NONE only where a source addresses the item's conversational behaviour and assigns no conventional sequential action
